definitions.explanation: A condition that must be met or a qualification that is necessary. Commonly used in legal, business, and technical contexts.

definitions.gloss: matter of business, purpose of a visit or call
definitions.explanation: The reason or business purpose for contacting or visiting someone. A polite way to ask what someone needs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧{要件|ようけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{要件|ようけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{満|み}たしていない→満たす：09889_mitasu⟧。
examples.english: It does not meet the legal requirements.

examples.japanese: ⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{要件|ようけん}⟦{定義|ていぎ}→定義：04789_teigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: We will carry out the system requirements definition.

examples.japanese: ご{要件|ようけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧でしょう⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What is your business? / How can I help you?

examples.japanese: {要件|ようけん}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{伝|つた}えて→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}った→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
examples.english: I conveyed just the business matter and hung up.

examples.japanese: {急|いそ}ぎ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{要件|ようけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{手短|てみじか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{願|ねが}い→願い：03529_negai⟧します。
examples.english: I have an urgent matter, so please keep it brief.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 ({要件|ようけん} as requirement) is common in formal, legal, and technical writing. In IT, {要件|ようけん}⟦{定義|ていぎ}→定義：04789_teigi⟧ (requirements definition) is a standard project phase. Sense 2 ({要件|ようけん} as business matter) is polite and often heard in business phone calls and office settings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {要件|ようけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{満|み}たす→満たす：09889_mitasu⟧: to meet requirements
- {要件|ようけん}⟦{定義|ていぎ}→定義：04789_teigi⟧: requirements definition
- ⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧{要件|ようけん}: application requirements
- ご{要件|ようけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: what is your business (polite)
- ⟦{必須|ひっす}→必須：12516_hissu⟧{要件|ようけん}: mandatory requirement

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{用件|ようけん}→用件：15058_youken⟧ (business, errand) is a homophone written with different kanji. ⟦{用件|ようけん}→用件：15058_youken⟧ is exclusively sense 2 — the purpose of a call or visit. ⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧ (condition, terms) is broader and less formal than {要件|ようけん} in the "requirement" sense.
